verdict.rationale: GitHub Mobile is an end-user mobile client for triaging, reviewing and managing Copilot agent tasks on the go, not a developer platform that exposes its own API surface, so building against official SDKs is a category error for this product type. The evidence describes only in-app features and shows no SDK shipped for the app. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes target the broader GitHub Docs site, not the mobile app.
